title: Technical Officer in Food Technology
description:
THE PAPUA NEW GUINEA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY
The Papua New Guinea University of Technology (PNG UoT) is seeking a qualified and motivated individual to join the School of Applied Sciences as a
Technical Officer in Food Technology
. Reporting to the Laboratory Manager, this vital role supports the academic and research functions of the school. The Technical Officer is expected to maintain effective management of laboratory operations, technical instruction and participating in the schools external Consultancy activities.
Primary Responsibilities:
Prepare and source laboratory materials and maintain analytical and processing equipment for undergraduate and postgraduate Food Technology students
Provide technical assistance to academic staff during laboratory experiments, food processing practicals and research experiments
Ensure compliance with Food Safety protocols, data integrity and ethical conduct as well as contributing to continuous improvements to the laboratories risk assessments
Maintain inventory records and oversee routine calibration and servicing of lab equipment
Assist in the procurement of laboratory supplies and consumables
Qualifications and Experience:
Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, or a related field
Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in a laboratory-based technical role, preferably in  the area or Food Microbiology within an academic setting or proven Food Industry related experience.
Sound understanding of Food safety and hazardous biological waste management
Strong organizational, leadership and communication skills.
Additional Attributes:
Ability to work collaboratively with faculty, students, and staff
Commitment to supporting academic excellence through reliable technical support
Self-motivated and capable of working independently under minimal supervision
Condition of Service
Technical Officer I/II                             PGK26,709 - PGK38,241 per annum
Domestic Market Allowance                   PGK1,200
(Level of appointment depends upon qualification and experience)
